name: OwnYourProduct
tagline: A salon's booking business under your own name: five-step set-up, comments answered with your prices, team, money.
description: A salon's booking business scaffolded into your repository: five-step set-up with prices anchored per country, Instagram comments answered with a fixed reply and a Direct quoting your prices, owner, manager and specialist levels, and money by service and specialist. Spanish, Portuguese, English.

screenshots.alt: Set-up, step 3 of 5: services pre-filled for nails and lashes with durations and prices anchored to Chile, ready to edit
Set-up, step 5 of 5: the review before publishing — business, services, hours and team about to be written into Bookings and the Knowledge Base
Knowledge Base overview right after set-up: business profile, eleven services and eight FAQs filled in, readiness score shown
Bookings, Services tab: the services created by set-up with their durations and prices
Comment Studio: the keyword list, the public reply and the Direct quoting the salon's prices, with the switch to turn the rule on

provides.name: Set-up
provides.description: Business, specialities, services with prices anchored per country, hours and team in five steps — written into Bookings and the Knowledge Base, idempotent.

provides.name: Comment Studio
provides.description: One keyword rule on Instagram post comments: a fixed public reply and a Direct quoting the salon's prices. No AI; Spanish, Portuguese, English.

provides.name: Team
provides.description: Owner, manager and specialist levels over the auth module, e-mail invitations, a specialist tied to her Bookings column.

provides.name: Money
provides.description: Revenue by service, specialist and client per period, expenses and supplies, CSV export — computed from the bookings.
